title: sherardia arvensis subsp. maritima
intro: Sherardia arvensis subsp. maritima, commonly known as Sea Sherardia, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sea Sherardia are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. These constituents may help to protect against oxidative stress, modulate the immune system, and exhibit potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities.
